stoodie_notation_rules.range: A-B means every valid Stoodie level from A through B, inclusive.
stoodie_notation_rules.separate: A & B (or comma-separated values) means the listed levels only.

field_notes.affects_skill: Not explicitly provided in the supplied list, so it is left null rather than inferred from effect text.

registlets.name: Accuracy Boost
registlets.effect: Increases accuracy by 1 per regislet level.

registlets.name: Arrow Rain Enhancer
registlets.effect: An additional attack is added to the skill "Arrow Rain" (+1 hit per level)

registlets.name: Assassin Stab Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Assassin Stab" by (1% per level)%. Furthermore, the accuracy is raised by (10 × level)% if it is Back Stab.

registlets.name: Attack Speed Boost
registlets.effect: Increases ASPD by 1 per regislet level.

registlets.name: Attacker's Pet
registlets.effect: Raises the damage dealt by pet by 3% per registlet level, but greatly decreases its owner's damage.

registlets.name: Aura Blade Force
registlets.effect: Releases a shock wave (single target attack). Dealing 10(+10 per regislet level)% damage if the monster targeted by "Aura Blade" is out of range.

registlets.name: Berserk Control
registlets.effect: For each level of "Berserk", 10% chance to prevent "Rampage" from being cancelled

registlets.name: Berserk Rush
registlets.effect: Reduces the negative effect of "Berserk" by (1 × regislet level)% if you take damage from a monster while the skill is active.

registlets.name: Binding Strike Modifier
registlets.effect: Modifies "Binding Strike" so that it inflicts [Stun] to the target only and the [Stop] effect is removed.

registlets.name: Bloody Bite Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Bloody Bite" by 10% × Registlet Level.

registlets.name: Bloody Warrior
registlets.effect: Raises normal attack power and Attack MP Recovery by (5% × Registlet Level) while afflicted with Bleed.

registlets.name: Blue Zone Shield
registlets.effect: Reduces the damage from monster attacks shown with a blue warning by 1(+1 per Regislet Level)%. However, damage taken from single-target attacks increases by 10%(disadvantage). This damage reduction applies multiplicatively with other damage reductions such as Refinement, Resistance

registlets.name: Bullseye Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Bullseye" by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Burning Spirit
registlets.effect: Restores MP as much as (5 × Registlet Level)% of your Attack MP Recovery when taking damage inflicted by Ignite.

registlets.name: Cannon Spear Enhancer
registlets.effect: Adds a (10% × Registlet Level) chance of inflicting "Flinch" to the first attack of the skill "Cannon Spear".

registlets.name: Cat's Eye
registlets.effect: A MISS hit while you are Blind may be turned into a GRAZE hit when possible.

registlets.name: Chancy Trap
registlets.effect: Enables a trap skill to be set at the target's feet, but if it activates immediately, you will also be affected.

registlets.name: Check Out Notice
registlets.effect: When you get knocked out, you will declare it through Party Chat. If it is a Guild RAID, you will declare it through Say Chat.

registlets.name: Coffee Break
registlets.effect: Restores 10% of your HP when you defeat a monster. Cooldown: (30 - Registlet Level) seconds.

registlets.name: Comrade Familia
registlets.effect: The chance of the familiar summoned with "Familia" fleeing is reduced by 1%. Movement becomes 1 second faster for Advanced Familiar.

registlets.name: Critical Charging Slash
registlets.effect: Lowers the power of "Charging Slash" by [110 - (10 × Registlet Level)]% and guarantees a critical hit.

registlets.name: Cross Parry Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Cross Parry" by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Damage Check
registlets.effect: Displays an additional warning message when stepping on a warning area if the damage from the attack exceeds 50% of your current HP.

registlets.name: Dark Talent
registlets.effect: Sets skill effects that change based on element to dark element.

registlets.name: Decoy Shot Compress
registlets.effect: Halves the duration of "Decoy Shot" but increases the power by (10% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Direct Sonic Thrust
registlets.effect: The skill "Sonic Thrust" loses its swift effect, but gains an effect that ignores Evasion in return.

registlets.name: Distant Buster Lance
registlets.effect: Increases the power of "Buster Lance" by (10% per Regislet Level). The range and distance at which the power starts to weaken is Increased, making it always a long-range attack.

registlets.name: Distinct Parabola Cannon
registlets.effect: The skill "Parabola Cannon" now only hits monsters currently in combat and guarantees a critical hit.

registlets.name: Dodge
registlets.effect: Increases Dodge by (1 per Regislet Level).

registlets.name: Dominant War Cry
registlets.effect: Activation of "War Cry" will not be interrupted by Fear.

registlets.name: Dragon Fire Release
registlets.effect: The time to cast [Fire Release] is increased by 1 second, but the skill gains (2.5 × Regislet Level)% Magic Pierce. This increase in Magic Pierce doubles if [Blazing Explosion] is triggered.

registlets.name: Dragon Tail Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of the second hit of "Dragon Tail" by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Eagle Eye
registlets.effect: Reduces damage taken from behind (opposite camera direction) by 1% × Registlet Level. The damage will be further reduced when taken from directly behind.

registlets.name: Earth Talent
registlets.effect: Sets skill effects that change based on element to Earth element.

registlets.name: Earthbind Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Earthbind" by (5% × Registlet Level) if used with knuckles.

registlets.name: Elemental Trigger Slash
registlets.effect: Converts the element of "Trigger Slash" from fire to that of the weapon equipped.

registlets.name: Elemergency Care
registlets.effect: Reduces the MP Aggro triggered by "First Aid" by (1 × Regislet Level). Up to MP Cost 100 at the minimum.

registlets.name: Elemergency HP Heal
registlets.effect: Instantly restores (10 + Registlet Level)% of your HP when there is only 25% or less due to monster's attacks. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

registlets.name: Elemergency MP Heal
registlets.effect: Immediately restores (10 × Registlet Level) MP if there is not enough MP. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

registlets.name: Elemergency Repair
registlets.effect: There is a (5 × Registlet Level)% chance of having Armor Break status removed when the damage taken increases because of it.

registlets.name: Exclusive Bodyguard
registlets.effect: Reduces the Physical/Magic/Fractional damage received by the mercenary or partner summoned as a "Defender" by (3 × Regislet Level)%.

registlets.name: Express Assault Attack
registlets.effect: Removes [Knock Back] and [Slow] from "Assault Attack" and increases its power by (10% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Extra Recovery
registlets.effect: Adds a HP recovery effect to the skill "Recovery". The amount of HP restored is (10 × Registlet Level)% of the HP recovered by the Mini Heal learned.

registlets.name: Extreme Chronos Shift
registlets.effect: "Chronos Shift" can be activated even if there is not enough MP by consuming HP. 60(-10% per Regislet Level)% HP is required per 100 MP you're short of. This HP consumption could get you knocked out.

registlets.name: Extreme Concentrate
registlets.effect: Increases the activation rate of "Concentrate" by 1% per Registlet Level.

registlets.name: Extreme Whack
registlets.effect: Increases the activation rate of "Whack" by 1% per Registlet Level.

registlets.name: Fighter's Magic: Impact
registlets.effect: Changes the proration dealt by [Magic: Impact] to physical proration.

registlets.name: Final Resistance
registlets.effect: If you get knocked out last in the party, you will squeeze out every last bit of your strength to quickly revive for (5 + Registlet Level) seconds before becoming unable to battle again.

registlets.name: Final Talent
registlets.effect: Sets skill effects that change based on element to Fire element.

registlets.name: Flash Stab Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Flash Stab" by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Focus Demon Claw
registlets.effect: The power of "Demon Claw" is reduced by 100% but the skill will focus on attacking a single target.

registlets.name: Focus Dive Impact
registlets.effect: Turns the skill "Dive Impact" into an attack that pierces through a single target. Resistance to Dazzled is shortened by (2 seconds × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Focus Resonance
registlets.effect: "Resonance" will only enhance stats that affect concentration and precision, but the enhancement is reduced by [95 - (5 × Registlet Level)]%.

registlets.name: Forty Winks
registlets.effect: Shortens Sleep duration by (10% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Frugal Breathwork
registlets.effect: Reduces the MP Cost of [Breathwork] by

registlets.name: Frugal Heal
registlets.effect: Reduces the MP Cost of the skill "Heal" by

registlets.name: Frugal Shield Bash
registlets.effect: Restores (10 × Registlet Level) MP when "Shield Bash" inflicts [Stun].

registlets.name: Full Power Qi Charge
registlets.effect: When "Qi Charge" gives no effect, qi will increase by (10 × Registlet Level)% if the skill is activated using 2000 MP.

registlets.name: Guitarist
registlets.effect: Allows smooth song resumption with Ad-lib. A successful Parry with Ad-lib grants [Regislet Level] stack(s) of Beat Blast.

registlets.name: Hard Hit Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Hard Hit" by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Heal Bank
registlets.effect: The amount of HP recovered by "Mini Heal" and "Heal" is halved. Accumulates up to [Registlet Level] stacks of buff every 3 sec. When using the skill to heal an ally, the buff is consumed instead of MP to activate it.

registlets.name: Heal Hands
registlets.effect: Alleviates the reduced recovery of Heal-related Regislets by (10% per Regislet Level).

registlets.name: Holy Light Retribution
registlets.effect: There is a 1% chance that Lv[Registlet Level] light element Magic: Finale will activate when "Holy Light" hits the target.

registlets.name: Impetus
registlets.effect: Reduces movement speed decline due to Slow by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Instuctor
registlets.effect: Sets your own EXP Gain to 0 to increase the EXP Gain of the party member with the lowest level by 1% per Regislet Level. Less effective if there are multiple recipients.

registlets.name: Invincible Dauntless
registlets.effect: "Dauntless" accumulates 1 second faster, but the count will decrease by 9(- 3 per Regislet Level) when taking damage. However, it won't decrease if the damage is blocked with Guard or certain Mononofu skills.

registlets.name: Iron Fist
registlets.effect: Guard Break increases by (1% per Regislet Level) when barehanded or equipping knuckles (main only). The amount increased will be tripled if sub-weapon is empty.

registlets.name: Ironhearted Chronos Drive
registlets.effect: Changes the additional attack effect of "Chronos Drive" from magic attack (based on INT) to physical attack (based on STR).

registlets.name: Issen Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of the second hit of "Issen" by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Knight's Intuition
registlets.effect: Anticipate increases by 5% if a one-handed sword is equipped, equipping a shield will triple the amount increased.

registlets.name: Last Hero
registlets.effect: Restores (10 + Registlet Level)% of your HP and MP per knocked out party member when you are the only one left. Cooldown: 300 seconds.

registlets.name: Light Talent
registlets.effect: Sets skill effects that change based on element to light element.

registlets.name: Lunar Slash Absorber
registlets.effect: All "Lunar Slash" stacks are now consumed and MP is restored based on the number of stacks consumed. MP recovery amount is 1 MP × Regislet Level × Lunar Slash Stack Consumed. Lunar Slash stack additional damage is disabled when equipping this regislet.

registlets.name: Magadachi Amulet
registlets.effect: Raises magic damage reduction by the skill "Magadachi" by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Magic Attack Boost
registlets.effect: Increases MATK by (1 per Regislet Level).

registlets.name: Magic Defense Boost
registlets.effect: Increases MDEF by (1 per Regislet Level).

registlets.name: Magic Speed Boost
registlets.effect: Increases CSPD by (1 per Regislet Level).

registlets.name: Magic: Arrows Enhancer
registlets.effect: Adds 1 shot per Registlet Level to the skill "Magic: Arrows".

registlets.name: Magic: Blast Catalyst
registlets.effect: Shortens the time to cast the skill "Magic: Blast" by 0.2 seconds per Registlet Level.

registlets.name: Magic: Lance Catalyst
registlets.effect: Shortens the interval between shots of the skill "Magic: Lances" by 0.1 seconds per Registlet Level.

registlets.name: Magic: Storm Extender
registlets.effect: Lowers the power of "Magic: Storm" by 50% to make its effect last 1s(+1s per Regislet Level) longer.

registlets.name: Magic: Wall Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Magic: Wall" by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Magic Crystal Catalyst
registlets.effect: Reduces the casting time of "Mana Crystal" by (10 × Registlet Level)%, but the amount of MP recovered gets reduced by

registlets.name: Magic Defuser
registlets.effect: Immediately restores 100 MP if you survive a Mana Explosion.

registlets.name: Magic Thrash
registlets.effect: Raises normal attack power in exchange for Attack MP Recovery.

registlets.name: Max HP Boost
registlets.effect: Increases HP by (10 × Regislet Level).

registlets.name: Max MP Boost
registlets.effect: Increases MP by (10 × Regislet Level).

registlets.name: Maximizer Converter
registlets.effect: Switches [Maximizer] to activate MP Charge instead when used alone.

registlets.name: Mega Demon Wind Shuriken
registlets.effect: MP Cost of [Demon Wind Shuriken] increases by [200 - (100 × Regislet Level)], but, in exchange, the number of times the shuriken can hit without reduced damage is increased by

registlets.name: Mega Royal Heal
registlets.effect: The range of "Royal Heal" effect is increased by 1m per Registlet Level, but the amount of HP restores is halved.

registlets.name: Mega War Cry of Struggle
registlets.effect: Increases the aggro generated by the skill "War Cry of Struggle" by (300 × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Meikyo Shisui Preserver
registlets.effect: The effect from "Meikyo Shisui" remains when using a skill.

registlets.name: Meteor Magic: Crash
registlets.effect: The meteorites from "Magic: Crash" become much smaller in size, but the time of impact is shortened by (0.1 × Regislet Level - 0.1) and all meteorites will drop down even when not hitting the target.

registlets.name: Monophobia
registlets.effect: Restores 100 HP per 10 seconds when near a party member, but when not, 100 HP will be lost. Range is (3 + Registlet Level) meters.

registlets.name: Monster Hunter
registlets.effect: Restores 100 MP when you defeat a monster. Cooldown: (30 - Registlet Level) seconds.

registlets.name: Neural Control
registlets.effect: Reduces the amount of ASPD lowered due to Paralysis by (2% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Panic
registlets.effect: Restores (10 × Registlet Level) MP every 3 seconds, but all MP will be lost if you get aggro and this Registlet will be suspended for 30 seconds.

registlets.name: Paralysis Shot Extender
registlets.effect: Extends the duration of buff from the skill "Paralysis Shot" by 1 second per Registlet Level.

registlets.name: Parrier Storm Blaze
registlets.effect: A Guard check is added to the skill "Storm Blaze". A successful Guard will double the amount of MP recovered.

registlets.name: Parsimony
registlets.effect: Instead of consuming a triggered auto-item, the item cooldown is doubled. Cooldown: (40 - Registlet Level) seconds.

registlets.name: Perfect Triple Thrust
registlets.effect: Restores (10 × Regislet Level) MP if [Triple Thrust] is successfully activated without taking any damage when used alone.

registlets.name: Phantom Slash Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Phantom Slash" by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Physical Attack Boost
registlets.effect: Increases ATK by (1 per Regislet Level).

registlets.name: Physical Defense Boost
registlets.effect: Increases DEF by (1 per Regislet Level).

registlets.name: Piercing Heavy Smash
registlets.effect: Adds (5 × Registlet Level)% Physical Pierce to the skill "Heavy Smash" if used with knuckles.

registlets.name: Posion Heal
registlets.effect: (1% × Registlet Level) chance of having Poison status removed when taking damage inflicted by Poison.

registlets.name: Pommel Strike Enhancer
registlets.effect: Extends the duration of Paralysis caused by the skill "Pommel Strike" by 1 second per Registlet Level.

registlets.name: Power Resonance
registlets.effect: "Resonance" will only enhance stats that affect firepower, but the enhancement is reduced by [95 - (5 × Registlet Level)]%.

registlets.name: Power Shot Boost
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Power Shot" by (15% × Registlet Level) when Tumble is inflicted.

registlets.name: Power Wave Modifier
registlets.effect: Modifies the effect of "Power Wave" so that it raises normal attack power by [(Registlet Level + Power Wave Level) × 0.5]% instead of extending the range.

registlets.name: Protection Aegis
registlets.effect: When [Protection] is activated, the [Aegis] you've acquired will also be activated at the same time. Likewise, when [Aegis] is activated, the [Protection] you've acquired will also be activated at the same time.

registlets.name: Purifying Twin Buster Blade
registlets.effect: The power of "Twin Buster Blade" now increases based on the number of debuffs (max 1 types × Regislet Level) on the target.

registlets.name: Pursuit Relief
registlets.effect: Reduces damage taken by (1% × Registlet Level) when you can't move while afflicted with Flinch, Tumble, or Stun.

registlets.name: Pyrexia
registlets.effect: The chance of having Freeze status removed if you do a normal attack while frozen increases by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Rage Sword Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Rage Sword" by 10% per Registlet Level. Aggro doubles if the target is hostile towards you.

registlets.name: Red Zone Shield
registlets.effect: Reduces the damage from monster attacks shown with a red warning by 1(+1 per Regislet Level)%. However, damage taken from single-target attacks increases by 10%(disadvantage).

registlets.name: Remedial Rampage
registlets.effect: Removes the finishing attack of the skill "Rampage" and restores (50 HP × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Role Model
registlets.effect: Greatly suppresses your own damage output to increase your party members' EXP Gain by 1(+1 per Regislet Level)%.

registlets.name: Savior
registlets.effect: Grants a 10-second invincibility if you revive when all of your party members get knocked out.

registlets.name: Secret Chase ATK Boost
registlets.effect: Increases the activation rate of additional attack of "Secret Chase Attack" by 1% per level of the skill acquired.

registlets.name: Secret Combo
registlets.effect: Reduces aggro by (Registlet Level)% per 1 combo. Better effect with longer combo.

registlets.name: Shared Destiny
registlets.effect: Each party member excluding you will raise ATK and MATK by 1%, but [110 - (10 × Registlet Level)]% of HP will be lost whenever a member gets knocked out.

registlets.name: Shell Break Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the chance to inflict Armor Break with the skill "Shell Break" by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Short Performance
registlets.effect: Shortens the duration of dance skill effect by 5 seconds. *Does not apply to Spirited Dance.

registlets.name: Silent P. Defense
registlets.effect: Reduces the aggro generated when P. Defense is successful by (10 × Registlet Level)%.

registlets.name: Single Meteor Strike
registlets.effect: Reduces the number of meteorites dropped from "Meteor Strike" to 1, but the drop point will no longer be random. It will no longer inflict status ailments either.

registlets.name: Smash Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Smash" by (5% × Registlet Level) if used with knuckles.

registlets.name: Smoke Dust Extender
registlets.effect: Extends the duration of buff from the skill "Smoke Dust" by (1 second × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Sneak Attack Timer
registlets.effect: The skill "Sneak Attack" changes into a time-based buff instead of remaining use-based.

registlets.name: Sonic Blade Extender
registlets.effect: Extends the time you must reuse "Sonic Blade" to turn it into "Super Sonic Blade" by 1 second per Registlet Level.

registlets.name: Sonic Wave Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Sonic Wave" by (5% × Registlet Level) if used with knuckles.

registlets.name: Speed Resonance
registlets.effect: "Resonance" will only enhance stats that affect acceleration, but the enhancement is reduced by [95 - (5 × Registlet Level)]%.

registlets.name: Spinning Slash Compress
registlets.effect: Reduces the range of "Spinning Slash" and removes the knock back effect, but raises its power by (5% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Spiral Air Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the power of "Spiral Air" by (2% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Sprint Sheathe Remover
registlets.effect: Sheathing while moving will no longer occur.

registlets.name: Start Dash
registlets.effect: Normal attack has 0 second cooldown for (5 + Registlet Level) seconds when getting aggro from the target monster for the first time. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

registlets.name: Static Triple Thrust
registlets.effect: You will remain in the same spot when using the skill "Triple Thrust".

registlets.name: Steady Stance
registlets.effect: Reduces damage taken while afflicted with Stop by (3% × Registlet Level) if you stand still.

registlets.name: Sunbath
registlets.effect: When using Emotions that increase Natural Regen, an additional (25 × Registlet Level)% of MP will be restored.

registlets.name: Sword Tempest Extender
registlets.effect: Adds 1 hit to the skill "Sword Tempest".

registlets.name: Tanker's Pet
registlets.effect: Lowers the damage received by pet by (3% × Registlet Level), but greatly increases the damage received by its owner.

registlets.name: Target Declaration
registlets.effect: When you are drawing the enemy's attention (aggro), you will declare it through Party Chat. If it is a Guild RAID, you will declare it through Say Chat.

registlets.name: Transfer
registlets.effect: Lowers MaxMP by [1100 - (100 × Registlet Level)], but when you are knocked out, the remaining MP will be shared among your party members.

registlets.name: Tricky Shadow Walk
registlets.effect: Additional attack of "Shadow Walk" will no longer cause proration.

registlets.name: Twin Slash Enhancer
registlets.effect: Raises the critical damage from "Twin Slash" by (1% × Registlet Level).

registlets.name: Universal Ether Flare
registlets.effect: "Ether Flare" will recover Attack MP even if the element is not the target's weakness.

registlets.name: Unsheather Wind Release
registlets.effect: Adds Magic Pierce (5% per Regislet Level) attribute to the skill "Wind Release" and when the skill changes, an Unsheathe Attack attribute is added.

registlets.name: Violent Lunar Misfortune
registlets.effect: While Storm Reaper's buff is active the skill "Lunar Misfortune" becomes a close-range attack regardless of distance. (15 - Regislet Level) seconds cooldown after activation.

registlets.name: Water Release: Aqua Mirror
registlets.effect: Changes "Water Release" from a deployable skill to a buff skill.

registlets.name: Water Talent
registlets.effect: Sets skill effects that change based on element to Water element.

registlets.name: Wayfarer
registlets.effect: Increases EXP Gain by 10% but lowers damage dealt by (15 - Registlet Level)%.

registlets.name: Wind Talent
registlets.effect: Sets skill effects that change based on element to Wind element.

registlets.name: Zero Stance
registlets.effect: Damage dealt with skill activated without using a combo is multiplied by [1 + (0.01 × Registlet Level)]. *Does not apply to some skills such as charge skills.
